Rewrite the equation with the absolute value isolated:

$$|x-4| - 10 = 2 \implies |x-4| = 12$$

This gives two cases:

- $x - 4 = 12 \implies x = 16$
- $x - 4 = -12 \implies x = -8$

Both solutions check out: $|16-4| - 10 = 2$ and $|-8-4| - 10 = 2$.

The product of the two values is $16 \cdot (-8) = -128$.

ANSWER: -128
